[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for handling conflicts include: keeping calm, listening actively, communicating effectively, finding a compromise, taking a break, and seeking professional help if necessary.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is normal to have conflicts in relationships, and learning to navigate them constructively can strengthen relationships. Communication and understanding are key.
